subject: Hackers' Joy — mentor credit vouchers + trial extension request
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@hackersjoy.org>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-10T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hackers' Joy — mentor credit vouchers + trial extension request

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you're well — I'm Alex, Partnerships Lead at Hackers' Joy. We're running our annual 48-hour student & early-career hackathon on June 18-20 and expect ~1,200 participants across 150 teams. A recurring ask from mentors and teams is access to compute credits and longer trial periods for new platforms when they prototype.

Would Redwood consider: 
- Providing mentor voucher packs (10 vouchers, each valid for a one-month trial with 100k token allowance / $150 equivalent) for our volunteer mentors to hand out on the day, and
- A temporary trial extension for all registered teams (30-day extended trial for accounts created via our registration flow)

We can offer public thank-you placement in the event page, social shoutouts, and a short keynote mention. I've attached our sponsorship form and current mentor roster so you can see the scale.

Let me know what a realistic promo allocation looks like and any internal steps you need. Timing's tight — ideally we'd have codes by June 1 to distribute to mentors.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Partnerships Lead | Hackers' Joy Foundation
alex@hackersjoy.org
Attachments: HackersJoy_Sponsorship_Form.pdf; Mentor_Roster.csv
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Alex Rivera <alex@hackersjoy.org>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-11T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hackers' Joy — mentor credit vouchers + trial extension request

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. Love the timing and audience.

Quick answers/next steps from Redwood:
- We can do mentor voucher packs. Need to agree on voucher size and redemption limits.
- Trial extension for teams is doable via a promo code tied to your registration flow; will need legal/sales to OK limited terms.

Looping in Marissa (community programs) to recommend voucher sizing and available budget; and Karthik (partnerships ops) to handle promo delivery and tracking.

Marissa / Karthik — can you review the sponsorship form and signal what we can commit to? If approved, we should issue codes and a short T&Cs doc for the mentors to hand out.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Developer Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, Alex Rivera <alex@hackersjoy.org>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-13T10:54:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hackers' Joy — mentor credit vouchers + trial extension request

Thanks Vanessa & Alex. Reviewed the form — great fit with our community program. Proposed commitment: 
- Mentor voucher packs: 10 vouchers at 120k-token/month equivalent (good for 30 days), single-use per account, expire 60 days after issuance.
- Team trial extension: one-time promo code for 30-day trial extension for accounts created through your registration link; limited to registered Hackers' Joy accounts (we'll validate against your roster).
- Reporting: we'll provide a redemption report and basic usage summary two weeks after the event.

Logistics / ask from HJ: please send the final mentor roster CSV (email address, name) so we can generate single‑use codes tied to mentor emails. Also need an MOU (DocuSign) confirming usage/attribution.

Karthik — please generate the codes and a short mentors' T&C blurb. We'll budget this under community promotions (approved).

Marissa Cole
Community Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Alex Rivera <alex@hackersjoy.org>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hackers' Joy — mentor credit vouchers + trial extension request

Amazing — thank you all. Attaching the updated roster (small correction) and signing the MOU now. DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/MOU/HJ-2027-05-15

Quick notes:
- We'll have mentors distribute vouchers during mentor check-in; they prefer single-use links sent to their email.
- For the team promo code, we can integrate a hidden field on registration that will mark accounts as eligible — happy to share a CSV after the event if you prefer post-validation.

Looking forward to the shoutout during opening remarks — we appreciate Redwood's support.

Best,
Alex
Partnerships Lead | Hackers' Joy Foundation
alex@hackersjoy.org
Attachments: Mentor_Roster_v2.csv
